It is genuinely *distinct*: not a shield/guard/sentinel cliché, unfamiliar enough to stand out, yet semantically transparent once explained. Ownable: all four domain types are free, no Companies House clash, and while Pentera (penetration testing) is a sound-alike, it operates in a different vertical and market. The only minor risk is Penstock Group (healthcare SaaS), but they are low-profile and non-overlapping in buyer, product, or brand prominence. The name carries the wry, technical precision this founder-led consultancy should project.
